title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid input data and receives a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input valid user details including email, username, and password.
Submit the registration form.
Check that the user account is created in the database.
Verify that the response includes a valid JWT token.
Ensure a welcome or confirmation message is returned.

title: User Registration Input Validation
description: Ensure the registration form validates incorrect inputs and returns appropriate errors.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Submit registration with missing required fields (e.g., no password).
Verify that validation errors are displayed for missing fields.
Submit registration with invalid email format.
Verify that email format validation error is shown.
Submit registration with password below minimum length.
Verify that password length validation error is shown.

title: User Login Success
description: Verify that registered users can log in with correct credentials and obtain a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Input valid username/email and password.
Submit login.
Verify response returns a valid JWT token.
Verify user is redirected to dashboard or homepage.

title: User Login Failure
description: Verify that login fails with invalid credentials and appropriate error messages are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Input invalid username/email or password.
Submit login form.
Verify login is rejected with an 'invalid credentials' error.
Ensure no JWT token is issued.

title: JWT Token Authorization Enforced
description: Check that API endpoints reject unauthorized access when JWT token is absent or invalid.

steps.description: Call protected API endpoints without a JWT token.
Verify the request is denied with a 401 Unauthorized status.
Call protected API endpoints with an expired or malformed JWT token.
Verify the request is denied with a 401 Unauthorized status.

title: User Profile View and Edit
description: Verify that authenticated users can view and update their profile details successfully.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials.
Navigate to user profile page.
Verify the current user profile information is displayed.
Edit profile fields such as name, contact info.
Submit profile update.
Verify profile data is updated in database.
Check that updated info is retrieved correctly after refresh.

title: Multi-Company Creation and Management
description: Ensure users can create multiple companies, view and edit company details when authorized.

steps.description: Login as a user with company management permissions.
Create a new company with valid information.
Verify new company is saved and visible in the companies list.
Select an existing company and change editable fields.
Submit the company update form.
Verify changes are persisted and reflected in database.
Attempt to access a company the user is not authorized for.
Verify access is denied with appropriate error or message.

title: Subscription Plan Selection and Status Display
description: Verify that users can view current subscription plans with status and select new plans to upgrade or downgrade.

steps.description: Login and navigate to subscription management page.
Verify the current subscription plan and status is displayed correctly.
Select a different subscription plan (upgrade or downgrade).
Confirm the change plan request.
Verify subscription status updates accordingly in the system.
Ensure access rights update according to new subscription level.

title: Subscription Plan Access Restrictions
description: Check that features not included in the current subscription plan are restricted and guarded.

steps.description: Login with a user having a limited subscription plan.
Attempt to access features or pages reserved for higher subscription tiers.
Verify the feature is blocked or a prompt to upgrade is displayed.
Attempt to bypass UI restrictions via direct API calls to protected endpoints.
Verify backend access control blocks unauthorized access.

title: Payment Processing with PayPal Success
description: Validate that users can initiate payment transactions through PayPal and that successful payments update the payment history.

steps.description: Login and navigate to payment/checkout page.
Select a subscription plan for payment.
Complete payment using valid PayPal credentials.
Verify that payment is processed successfully by the system.
Confirm payment transaction is recorded and visible in payment history.
Subscription status is updated if applicable post payment.

title: Payment Processing Failure Handling
description: Ensure appropriate error messaging and recovery options are presented to the user in case of payment failures.

steps.description: Attempt payment with invalid PayPal credentials or cancelled transaction.
Verify payment is declined or cancelled with clear error messages.
Ensure no payment record is created for failed transactions.
User is able to retry payment or select alternate options.

title: Dashboard Metrics Load According to Subscription
description: Verify that dashboard analytics, charts, and usage reports load correctly and reflect limitations based on user's subscription plan.

steps.description: Login as user with various subscription levels.
Navigate to dashboard page.
Verify presence and accuracy of available metrics and charts according to subscription privileges.
Attempt to view restricted metrics or data beyond subscription scope.
Confirm that restricted information is hidden or replaced with upgrade notices.

title: WhatsApp Chatbot Send and Receive Functionality
description: Ensure WhatsApp chatbot integration with Twilio is able to send and receive messages correctly and that AI auto-responses are triggered.

steps.description: Send a message to the WhatsApp chatbot via Twilio integration.
Verify the message is received on the backend.
Verify the chatbot processes the message using Google Gemini AI and sends an appropriate auto-response.
Send messages with various intents and edge cases to validate AI chatbot responses.
Confirm response relevance and correctness.

title: Route Access Control and Redirection
description: Validate access control over routes based on authentication and authorization, with proper redirection and 404 handling.

steps.description: Attempt to access authenticated routes without logging in.
Verify user is redirected to login page.
Login and attempt to access routes restricted by subscription or permission.
Verify access is denied or redirected appropriately.
Navigate to an invalid or non-existent route.
Verify that a 404 page is displayed.
After successful login or registration, verify user is redirected to the intended page.
Confirm the redirection is correct and user lands on expected destination.

title: Admin Panel User and Configuration Management
description: Verify admin users can manage users, permissions and application configuration settings through the admin panel.

steps.description: Login as an admin user.
Access the admin panel section for user management.
Create, edit, and delete users.
Verify user changes are persisted correctly.
Modify permissions or roles for users.
Verify access permission updates take effect.
Access configuration settings and update system parameters.
Ensure configuration changes apply and persist.

title: Health Monitoring and System Performance
description: Validate the health check APIs and that performance monitoring reports are accurate; verify Redis caching improves response time.

steps.description: Call the health monitoring API endpoints.
Verify system health status is reported correctly.
Perform frequent requests to endpoints that use caching.
Check that Redis cache reduces response times.
Verify cache invalidation occurs on data updates.

title: Database Migration Application and Rollback
description: Ensure Alembic migrations apply successfully and can be rolled back without data loss or corruption.

steps.description: Run new database migration scripts.
Verify schema and data changes are applied without errors.
Rollback migrations to previous version.
Confirm database schema and data revert safely without loss.
